environment.measurement: Single host, unisolated scheduling; concurrent proof workers can affect wall time.

lean.scope: Lean binary64, one Simpson mesh plus R8, radii, S and dS/dM and row output. Process timer also includes Lake, imports and elaboration with prebuilt oleans.

colossus.scope: Default z=0 top-hat spline. Fresh Cosmology with disk persistence disabled; table timing includes required power-spectrum construction. Cached array query includes mass-to-radius, S and spline dS/dM. Package imports and Cosmology constructor excluded.

scope: Floating-point numerical predictions. Kernel proof checking and the initial Lake build are separate workloads and excluded.
